title: lasianthus lowianus

It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lasianthus lowianus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate pain, and prevent infections.
